reasons.min_ram_mb:
RAM bumped 2048->4096 (2026-07-12): live-reproduced a genuine guest OOM on
FortiOS 7.2.4.F at 2048MB - the kernel OOM-killer repeatedly killed
httpsd/cmdbsvr/fgfmd/miglogd/forticron in a loop, so config never landed
and the node was never actually usable despite booting and staying up
(found chasing NPX-148/NPX-146: the OLDER 6.0-era build this profile's
2048MB default was originally tuned for is much lighter than modern
FortiOS's daemon set). Matches Fortinet's own current guidance: the 7.2.x
KVM admin guide states "minimum recommended RAM is 2GB" but later doc
revisions (7.6/8.0) strengthen this to "at least 4GB... recommended,
especially if UTM/ZTNA/proxy is enabled" - 2GB was never comfortably
sufficient for a full-featured modern build, just under-documented at the
time. min_ram_mb stays at 1024 (a real floor for older/lighter builds
like 6.0, which booted fine at 2048); default_ram_mb is what a NEW node
actually gets, now matching modern FortiOS reality.
